citations.venue: Neural Information Processing Systems
citations.authors: Charith Mendis, Cambridge Yang, Yewen Pu et al.

reception: External reception is modest and concentrated where one would expect, in the SLP vectorization literature. The line of SLP refinements from Porpodas and colleagues — VW-SLP and Super-Node SLP — positions its heuristics against goSLP's global ILP formulation, and Coyote does the same for vectorizing encrypted arithmetic circuits. Elsewhere the paper appears in lists of auto-vectorization work or as evidence about the state of SLP vectorizers; an evaluation of compilers' capability of automatic vectorization gives it a closer reading. The citations are few, but the substantive ones come from the community refining SLP itself. An evaluated and functional artifact accompanies the paper.
